/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Time
  Metric windows without a frame rate.

  Every observation carries a timestamp; a body also carries the path length it has travelled.
  A window is measured in one of the two: a duration of time, or a length of path travelled.
  Semantics are defined on the OBSERVED instants only; the one interpolation-free precondition is
  adequacy: a window of length d over a span is adequate when consecutive observations in the
  span are at most d/2 apart. An inadequate span yields `unknown`
  with the reason `samplingGap`, never a verdict invented between frames.

  Windows are computed for every instant of a trace at once: positions are monotone, so the
  window boundary moves one way and a two-pointer sweep with a range-maximum table over the gaps
  gives every window in O(n log n).

  There is no `next`, no rate and no frame count anywhere in the library.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Units

namespace TrafficSpec

/-- Milliseconds, monotone within a trace. -/
abbrev Timestamp := Int

/-- Which quantity a window is measured in. -/
inductive Measure
  | time | path
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr, Inhabited

/-- A window: a non-negative length in seconds (time) or metres (path). -/
structure Duration where
  measure : Measure
  length : Q
  deriving Repr

namespace Duration
def time (q : Q) : Duration := ⟨.time, q⟩
def path (q : Q) : Duration := ⟨.path, q⟩
end Duration

namespace Time

def ofTimestamp (t : Timestamp) : Q := Units.milliseconds t

/-- Consecutive gaps of a sorted list of positions (time or path). -/
def gaps : List Q → List Q
  | a :: b :: rest => Q.sub b a :: gaps (b :: rest)
  | _ => []

/-- Every consecutive gap in the span is at most `d / 2`. Vacuously true on one observation. -/
def adequate (d : Q) (span : List Q) : Bool :=
  (gaps span).all (fun g => Q.le g (Q.half d))

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Range maximum over the gaps between consecutive observed positions (sparse table).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- `gapMax.query lo hi` is the largest gap `pos[k] - pos[k-1]` for `lo < k ≤ hi`, given that
    every position in `[lo, hi]` is observed. -/
structure GapMax where
  table : Array (Array Q)      -- table[k][j] = max of gaps[j .. j + 2^k)
  gapsArr : Array Q            -- gapsArr[k] = pos[k+1] - pos[k], or zero where a side is missing

namespace GapMax
def log2 (n : Nat) : Nat := if n ≤ 1 then 0 else 1 + log2 (n / 2)

def build (pos : Array (Option Q)) : GapMax :=
  let n := pos.size
  let g : Array Q := (Array.range (n - 1)).map fun k =>
    match pos[k]?, pos[k + 1]? with
    | some (some a), some (some b) => Q.sub b a
    | _, _ => Q.zero
  let levels := log2 (max 1 g.size) + 1
  let table := (List.range levels).foldl (fun (acc : Array (Array Q)) k =>
    if k == 0 then #[g]
    else
      let prev := acc[k - 1]!
      let half := 2 ^ (k - 1)
      let row := (Array.range (prev.size)).map fun j =>
        if j + half < prev.size then Q.max prev[j]! prev[j + half]! else prev[j]!
      acc.push row) #[]
  ⟨table, g⟩

/-- Largest gap among the observations `lo, …, hi` (`lo < hi`); zero for a single observation. -/
def query (m : GapMax) (lo hi : Nat) : Q :=
  if hi ≤ lo then Q.zero
  else
    let len := hi - lo                  -- gaps indices lo … hi-1
    let k := log2 len
    let row := m.table[k]!
    Q.max row[lo]! row[hi - 2 ^ k]!
end GapMax

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Windows for every instant
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- The window behind an instant: the oldest in-window index, whether the trace reaches back past
    the window (an observation precedes it, or the oldest is exactly `d` behind), and whether the
    observations inside are at most `d/2` apart. -/
structure Back where
  j0 : Nat
  covered : Bool
  adequate : Bool
  deriving Repr

/-- The window ahead of an instant, symmetrically. -/
structure Fwd where
  jl : Nat
  covered : Bool
  adequate : Bool
  deriving Repr

/-- Index of the earliest missing position at or after `i`, per instant (size n+1; `n` when none). -/
private def nextMissing (pos : Array (Option Q)) : Array Nat :=
  let n := pos.size
  (List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
    let v := if (pos[i]?).getD none |>.isNone then i else acc[i + 1]!
    acc.set! i v) (Array.replicate (n + 1) n)

/-- Every back window of length `d`. `none` where the instant's own position or a position inside
    its window is missing (a gap the adequacy test could not see). Covered means an observed
    position precedes the window, or its oldest observation is exactly `d` behind. -/
def backWindows (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) : Array (Option Back) :=
  let n := pos.size
  let gm := GapMax.build pos
  let nm := nextMissing pos
  -- observedBefore[j]: some position at an index < j is observed
  let observedBefore : Array Bool := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Bool) j =>
    acc.push (acc[j]! || (pos[j]!).isSome)) #[false]
  let step (st : Nat × Array (Option Back)) (i : Nat) : Nat × Array (Option Back) :=
    let (j0, out) := st
    match pos[i]! with
    | none => (j0, out.push none)
    | some pi =>
      -- advance the oldest index while its position is observed and more than d behind
      let rec adv (j : Nat) (fuel : Nat) : Nat :=
        match fuel with
        | 0 => j
        | fuel + 1 =>
          if j ≥ i then j
          else match pos[j]! with
            | some pj => if Q.gt (Q.sub pi pj) d then adv (j + 1) fuel else j
            | none => adv (j + 1) fuel
      let j0' := adv j0 (i + 1 - j0)
      -- a missing position between j0' and i makes the window unknown
      if nm[j0']! ≤ i then (j0', out.push none)
      else
        let p0 := (pos[j0']!).getD pi
        let covered := observedBefore[j0']! || Q.ge (Q.sub pi p0) d
        let adequate := Q.le (gm.query j0' i) (Q.half d)
        (j0', out.push (some ⟨j0', covered, adequate⟩))
  ((List.range n).foldl step (0, Array.mkEmpty n)).2

/-- Every forward window of length `d`, by the same sweep run backwards. -/
def forwardWindows (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) : Array (Option Fwd) :=
  let n := pos.size
  let gm := GapMax.build pos
  -- observedFrom[j]: some position at an index ≥ j is observed (size n+1; false at n)
  let observedFrom : Array Bool := (List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array Bool) j =>
    acc.set! j (acc[j + 1]! || (pos[j]!).isSome)) (Array.replicate (n + 1) false)
  -- index of the latest missing position at or before i (n when none), per instant
  let lastMissing : Array Nat := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
    let v := if (pos[i]!).isNone then i else (if i = 0 then n else acc[i - 1]!)
    acc.push v) (Array.mkEmpty n)
  let step (st : Nat × List (Option Fwd)) (i : Nat) : Nat × List (Option Fwd) :=
    let (jl, out) := st
    match pos[i]! with
    | none => (jl, none :: out)
    | some pi =>
      let rec adv (j : Nat) (fuel : Nat) : Nat :=
        match fuel with
        | 0 => j
        | fuel + 1 =>
          if j ≤ i then j
          else match pos[j]! with
            | some pj => if Q.gt (Q.sub pj pi) d then adv (j - 1) fuel else j
            | none => adv (j - 1) fuel
      let jl' := adv jl (jl + 1 - i)
      let lm := lastMissing[jl']!
      if lm ≠ n && lm ≥ i then (jl', none :: out)
      else
        let pl := (pos[jl']!).getD pi
        let covered := observedFrom[jl' + 1]! || Q.ge (Q.sub pl pi) d
        let adequate := Q.le (gm.query i jl') (Q.half d)
        (jl', (some ⟨jl', covered, adequate⟩) :: out)
  (((List.range n).reverse).foldl step (n - 1, [])).2.toArray

end Time

  THE READING (the blueprint's; the coding session records here, per span, how each element,
  operationalization and composition below is written, and every choice the text did not dictate).

  Spans:
    d1 (subject): The driver of a vehicle
    d2 (obligation): shall not make a U-turn
    d3 (trigger): in an area designated as a school zone or school crossing zone
    d4 (boilerplate): except:
    d5 (exception): (a) When there are no children present;
    d6 (exception): (b) On a day on which school is not in session;
    d7 (exception): (c) During the period from a half hour after school is no longer in operation to a half hour before school is next in operation;
    d8 (exception): (d) If the zone is designated by an operational speed limit beacon,
    d9 (exception): during the hours when the pupils of the school are in class
    d10 (exception): and the yellow lights of the speed limit beacon are not flashing in the manner which indicates that the speed limit is in effect;
    d11 (boilerplate): or
    d12 (exception): (e) If the zone is not designated by an operational speed limit beacon,
    d13 (exception): during the times when the sign designating the school zone or school crossing zone indicates that the speed limit is not in effect.
    d14 (definitional): As used in this section, “speed limit beacon” means a device which is used in conjunction with a sign and equipped with two or more yellow lights that flash alternately to indicate when the speed limit in a school zone or school crossing zone is in effect.

  Elements (span → atoms, derived):
    d1: atoms ['ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle'], derived []
    d2: atoms ['prim.heading_change'], derived ['drv.motion.u_turn']
    d3: atoms ['dev.zone_sign', 'dev.governs', 'rel.occupies', 'st.travel_region'], derived []
    d5: atoms ['ru.child', 'st.region_geometry', 'dev.zone_sign', 'dev.governs', 'st.travel_region'], derived []
    d8: atoms ['dev.speed_limit_beacon', 'dev.governs', 'rel.occupies', 'st.travel_region'], derived []
    d10: atoms ['dev.speed_limit_beacon'], derived []
    d12: atoms ['dev.speed_limit_beacon', 'dev.governs', 'st.travel_region'], derived []
    d13: atoms ['dev.zone_sign', 'prim.conditions_hold'], derived []

  How each span is written:
    d1  `ru_aggregate x "DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"`, the binder's class.
    d2  the act: `drv_motion_u_turn x (p.u_turn_window, p.u_turn_reversal_tolerance)`, judged once,
        at its recognition (`rises`). The concept reads `prim_heading_change` over the window.
    occasion (boundary window) the act's observations are those within p.u_turn_window behind
        the recognition at which x yaws (`drv_motion_yawing x p.yaw_rate_resolution`, kin.yaw_rate):
        a span read `some_moment` is `¬ holdsFor W x ¬(U ∧ φ)`, one read `throughout` is
        `holdsFor W x (U → φ)`.
    d3  (some_moment) a device of kind zone_sign z, of kind school or school_crossing and not an
        end sign, governing a travel region r that x occupies. The zone's selection is written
        again, whole, in the obligation (z is not in scope there otherwise); where several signs
        qualify the duty is required for each selected one (`forallDevice … implies`), the
        record stating the duty of "the" zone x turned in.
    d5  (a) no road user c of class ru_child within p.child_presence_reach
        (`st_region_geometry_distance c q`) of a travel region q that z governs.
    d6  (b) `asm.school_not_in_session_day`.   d7 (c) `asm.outside_school_operation_margin`.
    d8–d10 (d) a speed_limit_beacon b governing a travel region g that x occupies or z governs,
        not flashing (`dev_speed_limit_beacon_flashing`), and `asm.pupils_in_class`.
    d12–d13 (e) no speed_limit_beacon governs a travel region x occupies or z governs, and
        `prim_conditions_hold z x` is false.
    Each of (a)–(e) is read `throughout`, alternative by alternative: one of them must cover
    every observation of the act. d14 is the node's residue. No narrowing of this file's own.

  No magnitude below is this file's own: parameters name the reading, literals are the text's.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Rule

namespace TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B_363_3

/-- The binders, as arguments (order and names are the node's). -/
def vX : Arg := .var "x"

/-- The reading's parameters; no value of any of them lives in this file. -/
def pChildPresenceReach : Term := .param "p.child_presence_reach"
def pUTurnReversalTolerance : Term := .param "p.u_turn_reversal_tolerance"
def pUTurnWindow : Term := .param "p.u_turn_window"
def pYawRateResolution : Term := .param "p.yaw_rate_resolution"

def zeroMetres : Term := .lit Q.zero .metre

/-- Quantifier variables: the zone sign, its region, the child's region, the beacon, its region,
    the child. -/
def vZ : Arg := .var "z"
def vR : Arg := .var "r"
def vQ : Arg := .var "q"
def vB : Arg := .var "b"
def vG : Arg := .var "g"
def vC : Arg := .var "c"

/-- Class of `x`: ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle -/
def clsX : Formula := .atom "ru_aggregate" [vX, .lit "DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"] []

/-- d2: x's U-turn (DEF-NRS-484B-077), recognized where it rises. -/
def uTurn : Formula := .derived "drv_motion_u_turn" [vX] [pUTurnWindow, pUTurnReversalTolerance]
def recognized : Formula := .rises uTurn

/-- The occasion's `under_way`: an observation of the act is one at which x yaws. -/
def underWay : Formula := .derived "drv_motion_yawing" [vX] [pYawRateResolution]

/-- φ at some observation of the act (with the act under way there). -/
def someMoment (φ : Formula) : Formula :=
  .not (.holdsFor .time pUTurnWindow "x" (.not (.and underWay φ)))

/-- φ at every observation of the act. -/
def throughout (φ : Formula) : Formula :=
  .holdsFor .time pUTurnWindow "x" (.implies underWay φ)

/-- d3: z begins a school or school crossing zone. -/
def schoolZoneSign : Formula :=
  .and (.or (.atom "dev_zone_sign_kind" [vZ, .lit "school"] [])
            (.atom "dev_zone_sign_kind" [vZ, .lit "school_crossing"] []))
       (.not (.atom "dev_zone_sign_end" [vZ] []))

/-- d3: x's footprint overlaps a travel region z governs. -/
def inZone : Formula :=
  .existsRegion (.lit "travel_region") "r"
    (.and (.atom "dev_governs" [vZ, vR] []) (.atom "rel_occupies" [vX, vR] []))

/-- d3 (some_moment): z is the sign of the zone x was in during the act. -/
def zoneOfAct : Formula := .and schoolZoneSign (someMoment inZone)

/-- d5: a child within the presence reach of a travel region z governs. -/
def childPresent : Formula :=
  .existsUser "c"
    (.and (.atom "ru_child" [vC] [])
          (.existsRegion (.lit "travel_region") "q"
            (.and (.atom "dev_governs" [vZ, vQ] [])
                  (.cmp (.measure "st_region_geometry_distance" [vC, vQ]) .le pChildPresenceReach))))

/-- d8, d12: beacon b governs a travel region x occupies or z governs. -/
def beaconOfZone : Formula :=
  .existsRegion (.lit "travel_region") "g"
    (.and (.atom "dev_governs" [vB, vG] [])
          (.or (.atom "rel_occupies" [vX, vG] []) (.atom "dev_governs" [vZ, vG] [])))

/-- (a) d5: no children present. -/
def excA : Formula := .not childPresent
/-- (b) d6. -/
def excB : Formula := .asm "asm.school_not_in_session_day"
/-- (c) d7. -/
def excC : Formula := .asm "asm.outside_school_operation_margin"
/-- (d) d8–d10: a beacon designates the zone, pupils are in class, and it is not flashing. -/
def excD : Formula :=
  .and (.existsDevice (.lit "speed_limit_beacon") "b"
          (.and beaconOfZone (.not (.atom "dev_speed_limit_beacon_flashing" [vB] []))))
       (.asm "asm.pupils_in_class")
/-- (e) d12–d13: no beacon designates the zone, and z's sign indicates its limit is not in effect. -/
def excE : Formula :=
  .and (.not (.existsDevice (.lit "speed_limit_beacon") "b" beaconOfZone))
       (.not (.derived "prim_conditions_hold" [vZ, vX] []))

/-- Applicability: d2 recognized, d3 at some observation of the act. -/
def applicability : Formula :=
  .and recognized (.existsDevice (.lit "zone_sign") "z" zoneOfAct)

/-- Obligation: d2 (obligation): shall not make a U-turn — unless, for each zone sign selected as
    in the applicability, one of the exceptions (a)–(e) covers every observation of the act. -/
def obligation : Formula :=
  .forallDevice (.lit "zone_sign") "z"
    (.implies zoneOfAct
      (.or (throughout excA)
        (.or (throughout excB)
          (.or (throughout excC)
            (.or (throughout excD) (throughout excE))))))

def rule : Rule :=
  { id := "NRS_484B_363_3"
    laws := ["NRS-484B-363-3"]
    binders :=
      [ { name := "x", cls := clsX } ]
    applicability := applicability
    obligation := obligation
    assumptions := ["asm.school_not_in_session_day", "asm.outside_school_operation_margin", "asm.pupils_in_class"]
    intentions := []
    operationalizations := []
    residues := ["The section's own definition of a speed limit beacon; dev.speed_limit_beacon's contract (\"a pair or more of yellow lamps mounted with a speed sign, flashing alternately when the sign's limit is in effect\") already states it, and the elements of spans d8, d10 and d12 read that atom; it imposes no duty of its own."]  -- the node's, verbatim; not yours to change
    narrowings := []  -- one { span := "<span id>", why := "<why>", kind := "reading" } per reading you chose on a carried span (kind no_atom / no_operator where the words cannot be stated), explained in the header; the record's own narrowings are not restated
    surrogate := false }

end TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B_363_3

/-
  Witnesses for NRS_484B_363_3.

  Carriageway (axis-aligned rectangles, metres): lanes 10 (x 0…100, y 0…4, eastbound) and 11
  (y 4…8, westbound), with shoulder 17 (y 8…12) north of lane 11, the stretch beside the school;
  lanes 12 and 13 continue lanes 10 and 11 east of x = 100, lanes 15 and 16 west of x = 0.

  Instants: 36 scenes 1 s apart (t = 0 … 35 s). x (track 1, a motor vehicle 4.5 m × 1.8 m) runs at
  4 m/s. It drives east along y = 3 until 26 s, yaws at 90 °/s at 27 s and 28 s (the rate held over
  the second before each scene) and 0 °/s elsewhere: its heading is east until 26 s, north at
  27 s, west from 28 s, and each position is the one before plus the velocity of the scene — at
  27 s it stands at (X, 7) heading north, from 28 s it runs west along y = 7. X, the turning point,
  is 50 m unless a witness says otherwise. Its heading change over the 20 s U-turn window is 90° at
  27 s (90° short of the half turn, beyond the 30° tolerance) and 180° at 28 s: the U-turn is
  recognized at 28 s, and its act is the yawing observations, 27 s and 28 s (90 °/s is far above
  the 2 °/s resolution, 0 °/s at it). Every witness speaks of 21 … 35 s, where the 20 s windows
  behind the instant and the one before it are covered.

  Occupancy is read from each body's footprint (its box, every body heading along an axis): at
  27 s x heading north overlaps lane 11 and shoulder 17, at 28 s heading west lane 11 alone.

  Track 2 is a child (a pedestrian, 0.4 m × 0.4 m), standing on shoulder 17 at (50, 10), 1.8 m from
  lane 11, inside the 5 m reach; where it stands away, it is at (50, 16), 7.8 m from lane 11, or
  at (150, 10), 1.8 m from lane 13, which no school zone sign governs, and about 50 m from the zone.
  A child that moves does so at 6 m/s within one second. The zone sign is device 100, the beacon
  device 101; a sign with posted hours shows 7:00 to 16:00 on every day. Every figure here is the
  witness's own and appears nowhere in the rule.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B.NRS_484B_363_3
import TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders

namespace TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_363_3

open TrafficSpec

def m (n : Int) : Q := Units.metres n
def cm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres n

-- Binders ↦ tracks: x ↦ 1

def steps : Nat := 36

/-- x's yaw rate: the U-turn at 27 s and 28 s. -/
def yawAt (k : Nat) : Q := if k = 27 ∨ k = 28 then Units.degrees 90 else Q.zero

/-- An axis-aligned rectangular region. -/
structure Box where
  id : RegionId
  kind : StructureKind
  x0 : Q
  y0 : Q
  x1 : Q
  y1 : Q

def boxes : List Box :=
  [ ⟨10, .lane, m 0, m 0, m 100, m 4⟩
  , ⟨11, .lane, m 0, m 4, m 100, m 8⟩
  , ⟨12, .lane, m 100, m 0, m 200, m 4⟩
  , ⟨13, .lane, m 100, m 4, m 200, m 8⟩
  , ⟨15, .lane, m (-100), m 0, m 0, m 4⟩
  , ⟨16, .lane, m (-100), m 4, m 0, m 8⟩
  , ⟨17, .shoulder, m 0, m 8, m 100, m 12⟩ ]

def roads : List Structure := boxes.map fun b => Build.rect b.id b.kind b.x0 b.y0 b.x1 b.y1

/-- The regions a body's footprint overlaps (with positive area); every body heads along an axis. -/
def occupied (u : RoadUser) : List (TrackId × RegionId) :=
  match u.kin.position, u.kin.heading, u.kin.extent with
  | some (px, py), some h, some (hl, hw, _) =>
    let ax := if Q.isZero h.1 then hw else hl
    let ay := if Q.isZero h.1 then hl else hw
    boxes.filterMap fun b =>
      if Q.lt b.x0 (Q.add px ax) && Q.lt (Q.sub px ax) b.x1 && Q.lt b.y0 (Q.add py ay) && Q.lt (Q.sub py ay) b.y1
      then some (u.track, b.id) else none
  | _, _, _ => []

/-- x's position and heading at k, for a turn at (X, 7). -/
def xPose (X : Q) (k : Nat) : Vec × Vec :=
  if k ≤ 26 then ((Q.sub X (Q.mul (m 4) (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat (26 - k)))), m 3), Build.east)
  else if k = 27 then ((X, m 7), Build.north)
  else ((Q.sub X (Q.mul (m 4) (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat (k - 27)))), m 7), Build.west)

def nearChild : Vec := (m 50, m 10)
def awayChild : Vec := (m 50, m 16)
def farChild : Vec := (m 150, m 10)

def schoolZone (gov : List RegionId) (conds : Option Conditions) : Device :=
  Build.zoneSign 100 gov .school false conds
def beaconOn (gov : List RegionId) (flashing : Bool) : Device :=
  { (Build.device 101 .speedLimitBeacon gov) with flashing := some flashing }
/-- The legend's posted hours: 7:00 to 16:00, every day. -/
def postedHours : Conditions := { windows := [{ startMinute := 420, endMinute := 960 }] }
def clock (minute : Nat) : Option CivilTime :=
  some { year := 2026, month := 11, day := 11, weekday := 2, minuteOfDay := minute }

/-- The baseline is `forbid`: a child near, school in session, inside the operation margin,
    pupils in class, a flashing beacon governing the zone's lanes, the sign unconditional. -/
structure Setup where
  xClasses : List RoadUserClass := [.motorVehicle]
  turnX : Q := m 50
  childClasses : List RoadUserClass := [.pedestrian, .child]
  /-- The child's position, heading and speed at k. -/
  child : Nat → Vec × Vec × Q := fun _ => (nearChild, Build.north, Q.zero)
  zones : List Device := [schoolZone [10, 11] (some {})]
  beacons : Nat → List Device := fun _ => [beaconOn [10, 11] true]
  civil : Nat → Option CivilTime := fun _ => none
  notInSession : Bool := false
  outsideMargin : Bool := false
  pupilsInClass : Bool := true

def build (s : Setup) : Trace :=
  Build.trace steps 0 (Units.seconds 1) fun k t =>
    let (xp, xh) := xPose s.turnX k
    let x := Build.withKin
      (Build.user 1 s.xClasses xp xh (Units.metresPerSecond 4) (cm 225, cm 90, cm 75))
      fun kin => { kin with yawRate := some (yawAt k) }
    let (cp, ch, cv) := s.child k
    let c := Build.user 2 s.childClasses cp ch cv (cm 20, cm 20, cm 60)
    Build.scene t (some 1) [x, c] roads (s.zones ++ s.beacons k) (some (occupied x ++ occupied c))
      { civilTime := s.civil k }
      [ ("asm.school_not_in_session_day", s.notInSession)
      , ("asm.outside_school_operation_margin", s.outsideMargin)
      , ("asm.pupils_in_class", s.pupilsInClass) ]

/-- `forbid` (violated): x (ru.motor_vehicle) makes a U-turn on a lane governed by a school zone sign z; a ru.child stands within p.child_presence_reach of z's lane at every observation, asm.school_not_in_session_day and asm.outside_school_operation_margin are declared false, and a speed limit beacon governing the lane is flashing. -/
def forbidTrace : Trace := build {}

/-- `permit` (compliant): x makes a U-turn on z's lane while no ru.child lies within p.child_presence_reach of any region z governs at any observation of the act. The child stands beside lane 13, outside the zone. -/
def permitTrace : Trace := build { child := fun _ => (farChild, Build.north, Q.zero) }

/-- `idle` (not_applicable): x makes a U-turn on a street no school zone or school crossing zone sign governs. The sign governs lanes 12 and 13 only. -/
def idleTrace : Trace := build { zones := [schoolZone [12, 13] (some {})] }

/-- `blind` (unknown): x drives along z's lane with children on the sidewalk and turns about, but its yaw rate is missing, so whether a U-turn was made is unknown. -/
def blindTrace : Trace := Build.masked (Build.manifest ["kin.yaw_rate"]) forbidTrace

/-- `occasion_d3` (violated): Baseline as in forbid (children present, school in session, inside the operation margin, beacon flashing): x begins its U-turn on z's lane and completes it on a lane beyond the stretch z governs; it occupied z's lane for part of the act only. Turning at x = 1 m, it is on lane 11 at 27 s and on lane 16 alone at 28 s. -/
def occasion_d3Trace : Trace := build { turnX := m 1 }

/-- `occasion_d3_outside` (not_applicable): x drove along z's lane, left the governed stretch, and only afterwards, on a lane no zone sign governs, makes its U-turn: it was in the zone before the act began only. Turning at x = 110 m, it leaves lane 10 after 24 s and turns on lane 13. -/
def occasion_d3_outsideTrace : Trace := build { turnX := m 110 }

/-- `occasion_d5` (violated): U-turn on z's lane; no ru.child is within p.child_presence_reach at the first observations of the act, then a child walks up beside the lane before the act is recognized; the other alternatives fail throughout. The child is 7.8 m away until 27 s and 1.8 m from 28 s. -/
def occasion_d5Trace : Trace :=
  build { child := fun k =>
            if k ≤ 27 then (awayChild, Build.south, Q.zero)
            else if k = 28 then (nearChild, Build.south, Units.metresPerSecond 6)
            else (nearChild, Build.south, Q.zero) }

/-- `occasion_d5_outside` (compliant): Children stood beside z's lane before the act began and left; at every observation of the U-turn none lies within p.child_presence_reach; the other alternatives fail. The child is 1.8 m away until 26 s and 7.8 m from 27 s. -/
def occasion_d5_outsideTrace : Trace :=
  build { child := fun k =>
            if k ≤ 26 then (nearChild, Build.north, Q.zero)
            else if k = 27 then (awayChild, Build.north, Units.metresPerSecond 6)
            else (awayChild, Build.north, Q.zero) }

/-- `occasion_d8` (violated): A beacon governs the region x occupies at the start of the U-turn only; x ends the turn on a region no beacon governs; asm.pupils_in_class holds and the beacon is not flashing; z's conditions hold; children present, school in session, inside the margin: neither (d) nor (e) covers the whole act. The beacon governs shoulder 17, which x overlaps at 27 s and not at 28 s. -/
def occasion_d8Trace : Trace := build { beacons := fun _ => [beaconOn [17] false] }

/-- `occasion_d8_outside` (compliant): No beacon governs the region x occupied before the act; a non-flashing beacon governs every region x occupies during the U-turn and asm.pupils_in_class holds throughout it; children present. z governs lane 10 and shoulder 17, the beacon lane 11: x is on lanes 15 and 10 before the act and on lane 11 throughout it. -/
def occasion_d8_outsideTrace : Trace :=
  build { zones := [schoolZone [10, 17] (some {})]
          beacons := (fun _ => [beaconOn [11] false]) }

/-- `occasion_d10` (violated): A beacon governs z's lane and asm.pupils_in_class holds throughout; the beacon is not flashing for the first part of the U-turn and flashing for the rest; children present. The beacon governs lane 10; it flashes from 28 s. -/
def occasion_d10Trace : Trace := build { beacons := fun k => [beaconOn [10] (28 ≤ k)] }

/-- `occasion_d10_outside` (compliant): A beacon governs z's lane and asm.pupils_in_class holds throughout; the beacon was flashing before the act and is not flashing at any observation of the U-turn; children present. The beacon governs lane 10, where x is not during the act; it flashes until 26 s. -/
def occasion_d10_outsideTrace : Trace := build { beacons := fun k => [beaconOn [10] (k ≤ 26)] }

/-- `occasion_d12` (violated): No beacon governs the region x occupies at the start of the U-turn, a flashing beacon governs the region it ends on; z's conditions do not hold throughout; children present, school in session, inside the margin. Turning at x = 1 m, x ends on lane 16, which the beacon governs; it is 18:00. -/
def occasion_d12Trace : Trace :=
  build { turnX := m 1
          zones := [schoolZone [10, 11] (some postedHours)]
          civil := (fun _ => clock 1080)
          beacons := (fun _ => [beaconOn [16] true]) }

/-- `occasion_d12_outside` (compliant): A beacon governed the region x occupied before the act; no beacon governs any region x occupies or z governs during the U-turn; z's conditions do not hold throughout; children present. The beacon governs lane 15, x's approach until 13 s; it is 18:00. -/
def occasion_d12_outsideTrace : Trace :=
  build { zones := [schoolZone [10, 11] (some postedHours)]
          civil := (fun _ => clock 1080)
          beacons := (fun _ => [beaconOn [15] true]) }

/-- `occasion_d13` (violated): No beacon; env.civil_time leaves z's posted window during the U-turn, so z's conditions do not hold for the first part of the act and hold for the rest; children present, school in session, inside the margin. It is 6:59 until 27 s and 7:00 from 28 s. -/
def occasion_d13Trace : Trace :=
  build { zones := [schoolZone [10, 11] (some postedHours)]
          beacons := (fun _ => [])
          civil := (fun k => clock (if 28 ≤ k then 420 else 419)) }

/-- `occasion_d13_outside` (compliant): No beacon; z's conditions held before the act and do not hold at any observation of the U-turn; children present. It is 15:59 until 26 s and 16:00 from 27 s. -/
def occasion_d13_outsideTrace : Trace :=
  build { zones := [schoolZone [10, 11] (some postedHours)]
          beacons := (fun _ => [])
          civil := (fun k => clock (if k ≤ 26 then 959 else 960)) }

/-- `branch_1` (compliant): x makes a U-turn on z's lane with children present while asm.school_not_in_session_day is declared true at every observation of the act. -/
def branch_1Trace : Trace := build { notInSession := true }

/-- `branch_2` (compliant): as forbid, but asm.outside_school_operation_margin is declared true throughout: exception (c). -/
def branch_2Trace : Trace := build { outsideMargin := true }

/-- `branch_3` (not_applicable): as forbid, but the school zone sign is an end sign. -/
def branch_3Trace : Trace := build { zones := [Build.zoneSign 100 [10, 11] .school true (some {})] }

/-- `branch_4` (not_applicable): as forbid, but the sign begins a pedestrian safety zone, not a school zone. -/
def branch_4Trace : Trace := build { zones := [Build.zoneSign 100 [10, 11] .pedestrianSafety false (some {})] }

/-- `branch_5` (not_applicable): as forbid, but x is a bicycle, no vehicle of DEF-NRS-484A-320. -/
def branch_5Trace : Trace := build { xClasses := [.bicycle] }

/-- `branch_6` (compliant): as forbid, but the pedestrian beside the lane is an adult: no child is present. -/
def branch_6Trace : Trace := build { childClasses := [.pedestrian] }

/-- `branch_7` (violated): a non-flashing beacon governs z's lanes, but the pupils are not in class: (d) fails, and the beacon defeats (e). -/
def branch_7Trace : Trace :=
  build { beacons := (fun _ => [beaconOn [10, 11] false]), pupilsInClass := false }

/-- `branch_8` (compliant): z's posted hours are over (18:00, no beacon), so (e) covers the act; an end sign 102 also governs z's lanes, unconditionally, and is no zone x turned in. -/
def branch_8Trace : Trace :=
  build { zones := [schoolZone [10, 11] (some postedHours), Build.zoneSign 102 [10, 11] .school true (some {})]
          beacons := (fun _ => [])
          civil := (fun _ => clock 1080) }

/-- `branch_9` (compliant): as branch_8, with a speed zone sign 102 governing z's lanes instead of the end sign. -/
def branch_9Trace : Trace :=
  build { zones := [schoolZone [10, 11] (some postedHours), Build.zoneSign 102 [10, 11] .speedZone false (some {})]
          beacons := (fun _ => [])
          civil := (fun _ => clock 1080) }

/-- `branch_10` (compliant): as branch_8, with an unconditional school zone sign 102 governing lanes 12 and 13, where x never is. -/
def branch_10Trace : Trace :=
  build { zones := [schoolZone [10, 11] (some postedHours), Build.zoneSign 102 [12, 13] .school false (some {})]
          beacons := (fun _ => [])
          civil := (fun _ => clock 1080) }

def witness (name : String) (τ : Trace) (expected : Verdict)
    (absent : List String := []) (boundary : String := "") : Scenario :=
  { name := name
    rule := "NRS_484B_363_3"
    trace := τ
    reading := {}          -- ignored by the gate: the run's reading is substituted
    manifest := Build.manifest absent
    grounding := [("x", 1)]
    expected := expected
    window := some (21000, 35000)
    boundary := boundary }

def scenarios : List Scenario :=
  [ witness "forbid" forbidTrace .violated
  , witness "permit" permitTrace .compliant
  , witness "idle" idleTrace .notApplicable
  , witness "blind" blindTrace (.unknown []) ["kin.yaw_rate"]
  , witness "occasion_d3" occasion_d3Trace .violated
  , witness "occasion_d3_outside" occasion_d3_outsideTrace .notApplicable
  , witness "occasion_d5" occasion_d5Trace .violated
  , witness "occasion_d5_outside" occasion_d5_outsideTrace .compliant

# NRS_484B_363_3 — task result

## Final verdict

`UNUSED_CLAIM prim_heading_change`. The node is wrong in span d2: see below. Everything else
passes: with a temporary always-true use of `prim_heading_change` (now removed) the gate returned
`OK` (26 witnesses, 16 names).

## Gate runs (5 of 6 used)

1. `UNUSED_CLAIM` (every claimed name). I ran this by mistake on the untouched skeleton.
2. `UNUSED_CLAIM prim_heading_change`. This was the first full rule and witness set.
3. `WITNESS_FAIL` (every witness). This run had the temporary probe in. The adapter refused the
   traces: the heading at a scene must be the previous heading turned by that scene's yaw rate,
   held over the interval before it. My first witnesses yawed 36 °/s with headings that did not
   follow.
   - Change: I rebuilt the motion so it is consistent. Yaw is 90 °/s at 27 s and 28 s, so the
     heading goes east, north, west.
   - Each position is the previous one plus the scene's velocity.
   - Occupancy is computed from each body's footprint box.
   - A child that moves does so with a matching velocity.
4. `OK` with the probe. The probe was `|prim_heading_change x W| ≥ 0°`, conjoined into the
   applicability only to find out whether the rest of the rule and witnesses pass.
5. `UNUSED_CLAIM prim_heading_change` on the final files, after I removed the probe. The probe
   always holds wherever it is decided. It is padding, not the law's meaning, so I did not leave
   it in to get an `OK`.

## The node defect (span d2)

The d2 element claims `atoms: ["prim.heading_change"]` and `derived: ["drv.motion.u_turn"]`. The
accepted concept `drv.motion.u_turn` already reads the heading change: its contract says it is
"the absolute value of x's signed heading change over the window behind it (prim.heading_change
with window …)", and it reads `kin.yaw_rate`. The rule states the U-turn through that concept
(`rises (drv_motion_u_turn x (p.u_turn_window, p.u_turn_reversal_tolerance))`). Nothing in the
node's words needs the heading change outside the concept.

A direct use of `prim_heading_change` in the rule would do one of two things:
- Restate the concept's body, which also needs a half-turn literal (180°) that the node does not
  declare.
- Add a vacuous conjunct, like the probe.

The gate does not count the concept's own reading as the rule's use of the claim. So the claim
cannot be met honestly.

**What the plan must change:** remove `prim.heading_change` from the atoms of the d2 element. The
element would keep `derived: ["drv.motion.u_turn"]` with an empty atom list, or name only what
the concept denotes. With that change, the files as they stand should pass: the run-4 `OK`
differed from them only by the probe conjunct.

**Note on the gate:** it did not report the always-true probe conjunct as `VACUOUS` (run 4).

## How the rule is written (choices the node left open)

- **Act and occasion.** The rule judges the U-turn once, at `rises drv_motion_u_turn`. The act's
  observations are those within `p.u_turn_window` behind the recognition at which
  `drv_motion_yawing x p.yaw_rate_resolution` holds.
  - d3 is read `some_moment`, as `¬holdsFor W x ¬(U ∧ φ)`.
  - d5, d8, d10, d12 and d13 are read `throughout`, as `holdsFor W x (U → φ)`.
  - Each exception (a)–(e) is read throughout on its own, and the obligation is their
    disjunction.
- **d3 zone.** z is a `zone_sign` device of kind school or school_crossing that is not an end
  sign. It must govern a travel region r that x occupies at some yawing observation of the act.
- **One zone across formulas (rule 3c).** The obligation repeats z's whole selection and requires
  the exceptions for every selected sign (`forallDevice zone_sign z (selection → exceptions)`).
  With one zone, which is the record's case, this is the same as the record. With several, the
  duty is held for each. I chose this because the record speaks of "the" zone x turned in. If the
  plan meant "some selected zone", it should say so.
- **The exceptions:**
  - (a): no `ru_child` road user within `p.child_presence_reach` (`st_region_geometry_distance`)
    of a travel region z governs.
  - (b): `asm.school_not_in_session_day`.
  - (c): `asm.outside_school_operation_margin`.
  - (d): a `speed_limit_beacon` b governs a travel region that x occupies or z governs, b is not
    flashing, and `asm.pupils_in_class` holds.
  - (e): no beacon governs such a region, and `prim_conditions_hold z x` is false.
- I declared no narrowings of my own.
- **Witnesses.** There are the 17 planned witnesses plus `branch_2` to `branch_10`, so that every
  leaf moves a decided witness:
  - exception (c);
  - an end sign;
  - a non-school zone;
  - x a bicycle, which is not a vehicle;
  - an adult instead of a child;
  - pupils not in class;
  - a second sign that is not selected: an end sign, a speed zone, and a school sign off x's path.

  Every witness speaks of 21–35 s, so the 20 s windows are covered.

## Why I finished

The only remaining verdict, `UNUSED_CLAIM prim_heading_change`, comes from the node's mapping of
d2, not from the files. The task's procedure says to report such a mismatch, not to work around
it. I fixed the rule against the node once, and the verdict persisted.

## How the rule is written (choices the node left open)

- **Act and occasion.** The rule judges the U-turn once, at `rises drv_motion_u_turn`. The act's
  observations are those within `p.u_turn_window` behind the recognition at which
  `drv_motion_yawing x p.yaw_rate_resolution` holds.
  - d3 is read `some_moment`, as `¬holdsFor W x ¬(U ∧ φ)`.
  - d5, d8, d10, d12 and d13 are read `throughout`, as `holdsFor W x (U → φ)`.
  - Each exception (a)–(e) is read throughout on its own, and the obligation is their
    disjunction.
- **d3 zone.** z is a `zone_sign` device of kind school or school_crossing that is not an end
  sign. It must govern a travel region r that x occupies at some yawing observation of the act.
- **One zone across formulas (rule 3c).** The obligation repeats z's whole selection and requires
  the exceptions for every selected sign (`forallDevice zone_sign z (selection → exceptions)`).
  With one zone, which is the record's case, this is the same as the record. With several, the

  - (b): `asm.school_not_in_session_day`.
  - (c): `asm.outside_school_operation_margin`.
  - (d): a `speed_limit_beacon` b governs a travel region that x occupies or z governs, b is not
    flashing, and `asm.pupils_in_class` holds.
  - (e): no beacon governs such a region, and `prim_conditions_hold z x` is false.
- I declared no narrowings of my own.
- **Witnesses.** There are the 17 planned witnesses plus `branch_2` to `branch_10`, so that every
  leaf moves a decided witness:
  - exception (c);
  - an end sign;
  - a non-school zone;
  - x a bicycle, which is not a vehicle;
  - an adult instead of a child;
  - pupils not in class;
  - a second sign that is not selected: an end sign, a speed zone, and a school sign off x's path.

  Every witness speaks of 21–35 s, so the 20 s windows are covered.
